endpoint.definition: A published address for one context space's data, with its own rules about who may read which entities and attributes.

import.title: Import configuration

disable.title: Disable {name}?

enable.title: Enable {name}?

reset-password.title: Reset the password of {name}?

sign-out.title: Sign {name} out everywhere?
sign-out.body: Every open session ends. The person can sign in again.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.body: The person is disabled now. When groups or bindings name them, a Change takes them out of each; the account goes once that Change is approved. This cannot be undone.
